items.title: Could HBF be the solution to the Memory bottleneck?
items.summary: Investing.com -- The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence workloads is creating a growing demand for memory capacity and bandwidth, opening the door for a new storage technology that could ease infrastructure constraints while providing a fresh growth opportunity for the NAND flash industry, Bernstein said.

items.title: What Is Meta Platforms (META) Facing As Legal Risks Rise And AI Deals Expand?
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) joined Google and TikTok in suing California to block a new youth social media law targeting users under 16. Police in India registered a First Information Report against Meta after complaints over alleged child sexual abuse material on Instagram and Facebook. AMD disclosed agreements under which Meta may gain rights to about 320 million AMD shares as part of AI chip related deals. items.title: How sustainable is the AI investment boom after Thursday’s selloff?
